Shock is an On Hit Effect status which can also be applied by some Skills.

## Contents

- 1 Description

- 2 Known Modifiers

- 2.1 Character Stats

- 3 Affixes

## Description[]

Each stack of Shock reduces lightning resistance by 5% and increases chance to be stunned by 10% for 4 seconds.

Shock has a maximum of 20 stacks.

Shock has 60% less effect against bosses and players.

A chance to Shock greater than 100% can apply multiple stacks at once.
